translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content.text: Bɔ̃rurobɑ bɛɛ Yerusɑlɛmugibu.
Domi i sɑ̃ɑwɑ mɛm nɔɔ sɑribɑ,
mɑ i disi mɔ, i dɑm diinɑmɔ.
I ku rɑ googii nɔ.
I ku rɑ mɑɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑbu wure.
I ku rɑ Gusunɔ bɛɛn Yinni nɑɑnɛ ko.
I ku rɑ mɑɑ nùn susi.
Bɛɛn sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nge gbee sinɑn
si su kukirimɔ wuu ge sɔɔ.
Mɑ bɛɛn siri kowobu bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nge yokɑn purukɑ
ni nu ku rɑ dĩɑnu yi bururun sɔ̃.
Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɑɑnɛ sɑribɑ.
Bɑ ku rɑ gere ye Gusunɔ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Bɛɛn yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru disi dokemɔ.
Bɑ ku rɑ woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛ.
Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛɛ.
U sɑ̃ɑwɑ gemgii, u ku rɑ weesu ko.
U rɑ win gem terɑsiewɑ siribu sɔɔ bururu bɑɑtere.
U ku rɑ tɔ̃ru bure.
Adɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobɑ bɑ kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀, sekurɑ kun bu mɔ̀.
Wi, Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
u bwese girinu go,
mɑ u nin gbɑ̃rɑnu kɑ nin kuku yenu kɔsukɑ.
U derɑ goo ku rɑ mɑɑ sĩ nin swɛɛ sɔɔ.
U nin wusu kɔsukɑ, goo kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi.
Yerɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ Yerusɑlɛmugibu, ì n dɑɑ nùn nɑsie,
mɑ i win sɛɛyɑsiɑbu wurɑmɔ,
u ǹ dɑɑ bɛɛn wɑ̃ɑ yenu kɔsukumɔ.
U ǹ dɑɑ mɑɑ bɛɛ sɛɛyɑsiɑmɔ nge mɛ u kuɑ,
ɑdɑmɑ i rɑ n sɛndewɑ kɔ̃sɑn kobu sɔɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, wi, Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
i nùn mɑruo tɔ̃ɔ tè sɔɔ u koo se u bɛɛ wɔrimɑ.
Domi u gɔ̃ru doke u bwesenu kɑ nin sinɑmbu mɛnnɑ
u bu win mɔru sɔ̃ɔsi kɑ yen dɑm.
Kpɑ n sɑ̃ɑre nge bɑ tem mɛ kpuro dɔ̃ɔ doke win mɔrun sɔ̃.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo tɔmbun yɑri dɛɛrɑsiɑ
kpɑ bu win yĩsiru soku bu nùn sɑ̃ sɑnnu.
Be bɑ nùn sɑ̃ɑmɔ bɑ yɑrinɛ bɑɑmɑ,
bɑ koo kɑ nùn kɛ̃nu nɑɑwɑ sɑɑ Etiopin dɑɑnun gurun di.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, bɛɛ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ,
i ǹ sekuru wɑsi bɛɛn dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ kɑ bɛɛn torɑ ni i kuɑ sɔɔ.
Domi u koo be bɑ rɑ tii sue bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ wunɑ,
kpɑ bɛɛn tiin tɔn biɑru tu kpe win guu dɛɛrɑrun wɔllɔ.
U koo de tɔmbu fiiko bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ
be bɑ ǹ tii sue.
Bɑ koo win yĩsiru soku u kɑ bu kɔ̃su.
Isireli be bɑ tie, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ weesu mɔ̀.
Gɑri kɔ̃si yi ǹ ko n wɑ̃ɑ ben nɔsɔ.
Bɑ ko n wɛ̃rewɑ,
goo kun bu bɑɑsimɔ.
Bɛɛ Siɔnigibu, i gɔ̃ru dobun kuuki koowo.
Bɛɛ Isirelibɑ kpuro gesi, i nuku dobun kuuki koowo.
Bɛɛ Yerusɑlɛmugibu, i yɛ̃ɛrio
kpɑ i nɑsɑrɑn kuuki ko kɑ bɛɛn gɔ̃ru kpuro.
Yinni Gusunɔ u bɛɛn sɛɛyɑsiɑbu kpeesiɑ bi u koo rɑɑ bɛɛ ko.
U bɛɛn yibɛrɛbɑ yɑrinɑsiɑ.
Gusunɔ sinɑ boko, bɛɛ Isirelibɑn Yinni, u wɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ.
I ǹ mɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ gɑɑ wɑsi.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, bɑ koo bɛɛ Yerusɑlɛmugibu sɔ̃ bu nɛɛ,
i ku bɛrum ko Siɔniɔ.
I ku de bɛɛn gɔmɑ dwiiyɑ.
Gusunɔ bɛɛn Yinni u wɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ.
U sɑ̃ɑwɑ nge tɑbu durɔ wi u rɑ fɑɑbɑ ko.
U koo nuku doo bɑkɑbu ko bɛɛn sɔ̃.
U ǹ mɑɑ gɑ̃ɑnu gerumɔ yèn sɔ̃ u bɛɛ kĩ.
U ko n nuku doo bɑkɑbu mɔ.
Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu sɔɔ
yèn sɔ̃ bɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu tondɑ,
bɑ wɑ̃ɑ sekuru sɔɔ te tɑ bu buniɛmɔ nge sɔmunu,
mɑ bɑ ku rɑ mɑɑ win tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑnu di,
beyɑ u koo mɛnnɑmɑ.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, u koo be bɑ bɛɛ dɑm dimɔ wɔri,
kpɑ u yɛmɔbu fɑɑbɑ ko.
U koo be bɑ rɑɑ girɑ mɛnnɑ
kpɑ u de bu tɔmbu nuku dobu wɛ̃
kpɑ bu yĩsiru yɑri tem kpuro sɔɔ
mi ben bɑɑwure u rɑɑ sekuru dimɔ.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, u koo de i wurɑmɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, u koo bɛɛ mɛnnɑ.
Tɔmbu bɑ koo bɛɛ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃
kpɑ i yĩsiru yɑri hɑnduniɑn bwesenu kpuron suunu sɔɔ
sɑnɑm mɛ u koo kɑ bɛɛn yobu wurɑmɑ i bu wɑ.
Wi, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u yeni geruɑ.
